caption: The drawing depicts a metallic lantern with a rectangular body and a curved, arched handle attached to one side. The lantern has four glass panels, with the front panel containing a small latch for opening. The top of the lantern is covered with a rounded metal shield that has an oval opening in the center. The colors in the drawing are primarily shades of gray and brown, with black detailing to suggest shadows and the metallic texture. The lantern is placed against a plain, off-white or light beige background, and the artist's signature along with the date "9-37" appears in the lower left corner. There are two small brownish spots near the upper center area and another faint spot to the lower left of the lantern.
title: Economy Square Oil Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
